title: kbingest survey reports a repository's toolchain pins
goal: python3 _tools/kbingest.py survey REPO --pins prints, per pin file found at the commit, the file, the pin and its value for Python (.python-version, requires-python), Node (engines, devEngines, packageManager, .nvmrc), TypeScript (tsconfig extends), Go (go.mod go/toolchain, go.work), Rust (rust-toolchain(.toml) channel, Cargo rust-version/edition), Java (maven.compiler.release, gradle-wrapper distributionUrl), .NET (global.json sdk.version/rollForward, TargetFramework(s), LangVersion, packages.lock.json, Directory.Packages.props), PowerShell (#Requires, .psd1 PowerShellVersion/CompatiblePSEditions/RequiredModules) and environment (devcontainer.json image/features, devcontainer-lock.json, .tool-versions, mise.toml); read with git cat-file and the standard library only, never executing repository code; this repository's survey shows .python-version and requires-python.
